content: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy involves placing the patient in a pressurized chamber where they breathe 100% oxygen, which significantly increases the amount of oxygen delivered to tissues, promoting enhanced wound healing and reducing the risk of infection. Topical oxygen therapy delivers oxygen directly to the wound site through specialized devices, improving local oxygenation and supporting the repair of damaged tissues. Oxygen-releasing sprays are applied directly to the wound surface, releasing oxygen over time to enhance cellular activity, accelerate healing processes, and minimize the likelihood of infection.
